t: This is Cutlers' Hall, in the City of London, in the EC4M postcode. It was designed by Thomas Tayler Smith, who lived from 1834 to 1909. He was a British architect and also an electrical engineer, an unusual pairing of skills for a designer of a livery hall. I don't have more detail on the building itself, so take a moment to look at its frontage and consider that it comes from one person's design.
